title: Cultural Authority Registry Entry
description: Operator consent record for Sacred Site / Indigenous protocol corpus access (Constitution VI-C non-negotiable + spec 036 FR-RAG-CA-04). Source of truth: Cosmos DB container `culturalAuthorityRegistry` in Australia East (NN-2 + FR-RAG-CV-04). Container is provisioned empty by the amend-loop deploy; population is HUMAN-IN-LOOP per FR-RAG-CA-05 (NEMA + AFAC + Indigenous community sign-off). When the registry is unreachable at retrieval time, the system fails closed for protected chunks and emits `cultural_authority_registry_unavailable` to the audit log per Pass 1 Q-P1-01.

operator_id.description: Entra ID / OID of the operator the consent is granted to. Cosmos DB partition key — co-locates an operator's consents on a single physical partition for low-latency single-operator lookup.

land_council_id.description: Identifier of the granting Land Council, ALT, APY, AIATSIS-registered authority, or other Indigenous community body. Free-form per Pass 1 Q-P1-01 (registry plumbing is in-scope; population is HUMAN-IN-LOOP per FR-RAG-CA-05).

granted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of consent grant.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of consent expiry. MUST be in the future at write time. Retrieval-time gate (ADR-12) treats current_time > expires_at as expired and fails closed for protected chunks.

granted_by_authority.description: Free-text identifier of the authorising body / signatory (e.g. 'Central Land Council', 'APY Lands Executive', 'AIATSIS Ethics Committee'). Audit-trail anchor per Constitution Principle IV.

scope.description: Granular scope of consent. Pass 1 Q-P1-01 enumerates four values; Pass 2 Q-P2-02 places the gate post-retrieval, in-process inside `RetrievalService.retrieve()` so the scope filter applies uniformly across all five grounded agents and the Simulation Controller.

signature.description: Detached cryptographic signature over `(operator_id, land_council_id, granted_at, expires_at, granted_by_authority, scope)`. Signature scheme MUST match the spec 032 FR-AI09 cosign keyless pattern OR the FR-RAG-LS-02 age-encrypted pattern; verification logic in `apps/agents/common/cultural_authority_registry.py` (planned Phase F-A2).

revocation_reason.description: Nullable string. Set when consent is revoked (e.g. 'operator role change', 'community-requested revocation', 'expiry past'). Once set, the row remains in the registry as an audit anchor but the gate fails closed on it (revoked rows are equivalent to no row).

examples.granted_by_authority: Central Land Council Cultural Heritage Officer (delegated)
Kimberley Land Council CHC + AIATSIS Ethics Committee co-signature
examples.signature: -----BEGIN AGE ENCRYPTED FILE-----\n... ...-----END AGE ENCRYPTED FILE-----
